## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test` pass in the folder I changed (`personal/` or `team/`)
- [ ] No real LinkedIn data (files, numbers, URLs, names, emails) in code, tests, seed data or screenshots
- [ ] Personal: no new network requests, external fonts, scripts or trackers
- [ ] Team: new tables or columns come with row-level security policies and a test in `team/test/db/`
- [ ] Team: if I added a migration, the description says users must run it
